inaccessible: Test execution because pytest is not installed in the analysis environment
Live target verification because it would perform network scraping and agent execution
analysis_scope.sampling_notes: All 33 tracked paths were inventoried. Core loop, evaluator, scraper, safety libraries, infrastructure tests, and documentation were sampled in depth.

stated_purpose: Run a bounded autonomous improvement loop in which Codex edits one scraper, evaluates results, and keeps or discards each change according to an objective score.

observed_capabilities.statement: The CLI creates isolated Git worktree sessions, bootstraps cached pages, runs bounded iterations, evaluates scraper output, and records kept, discarded, crashed, rejected, timed-out, or no-op outcomes.
The evaluator scores yield, required and optional fields, type validity, uniqueness, and request efficiency.
The repository contains response-analysis, circuit-breaker, adaptive-rate-limiter, smart-client, and cached/live validation components with unit and integration-style tests.
Agent edits are constrained and rejected when they modify forbidden files.

planned_work.statement: The status document lists main-loop circuit-breaker integration, session continuity, monitoring, and broader testing as pending work.

architecture.statement: A session-specific Git worktree contains the editable scraper and result log; the loop invokes Codex, validates the diff, executes the scraper in cached or live mode, scores artifacts, and commits or discards the candidate.
The human controls strategy through program.md and evaluation rules, while the agent is limited to scraper.py.

accomplishments.statement: The repository implements the complete cached experiment loop, including worktree isolation, agent invocation, scoring, keep/discard decisions, artifacts, and status summaries.
Committed tests cover evaluator behavior, keep/discard/crash/rejection/timeout paths, smart-client behavior, and fixture-based scraper output.

gaps.statement: CircuitBreaker exists as a library but is not referenced by the sampled main loop, matching the status document's integration gap.
There is no CI workflow to execute the committed tests automatically.
The implementation status document is partially stale because the current tree contains rate-limiter and broader tests while still describing them as future phases.

risks.statement: The loop can invoke an autonomous coding agent and live network scraper; incomplete circuit-breaker integration increases the cost of stalled or repetitive runs.

suggested_next_actions.statement: Run the full committed test suite in the intended uv environment, reconcile RALPH_IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md with the current tree, and either integrate CircuitBreaker into run_loop or explicitly defer it.

questions: Is AutoResearch intended to remain a reusable scraper experiment harness or become a general autonomous code-improvement framework?
Is the project still active after the July archive snapshot, or should it become showcase/reference?
Should live-mode execution remain part of the MVP or be treated as an optional validation stage?

evidence.summary: Defines the autoscrape MVP, quick start, loop, evaluation, modes, exit conditions, and file responsibilities.
Claims completed response analysis and circuit-breaker libraries while listing integration, session, monitoring, and broader test work as pending.
Implements session worktrees, agent prompting, diff restrictions, scraper execution, scoring, commits/discards, live validation, exit conditions, and CLI commands.
Implements deterministic output quality and efficiency scoring.
Contain response analysis, circuit breaker, adaptive rate limiting, failure detection, fingerprints, and smart HTTP/browser client components.
Eight test-like tracked paths cover evaluator, infrastructure, loop outcomes, scraper fixtures, response analysis, and circuit breaker behavior.
The revision contains 33 tracked paths and no GitHub workflow.
Three commits show the initial scaffold, cache/codex defaults fix, and July archive snapshot.

confidence.rationale: The core workflow is supported by implementation and representative test source, but tests and live behavior were not executed and the status document is partially stale.

limitations: Tests were inspected but not executed because pytest is unavailable.
No live scraping or Codex agent iteration was run.
The July commit message indicates an archive snapshot and does not establish current owner intent.
